s.how: Fry 2 sliced onions slowly until soft and golden. Grill 8 hot dog franks until they split. Tuck into soft buns with the onions and a stripe of yellow mustard, then wrap in paper. Eat them leaning on a car you are not buying.

s.note: the dusty wasteland of the Void
s.how: Slice 800g potatoes paper thin on a mandoline and rinse well. Dry thoroughly and fry at 170C in batches until crisp. Toss straight away with smoked paprika, garlic powder and sea salt. Serve in a big bowl, dusty as a wasteland.

m.how: Slice 2 onions into rings, dip in a flour and beer batter and fry until crisp. Shape 600g beef mince into 4 patties and grill, melting cheddar on top. Fry bacon until crisp. Build in toasted buns with an onion ring on top and serve with cold lager.

w.note: Deadpool's red suit next to Wolverine's yellow one
w.how: Blend 200g raspberries with a spoon of sugar and strain. Blend a mango until smooth. Scoop vanilla ice cream into tall glasses, spoon raspberry sauce down one side and mango down the other, then pile whipped cream on top.

d.how: Set one big ice cube in each short glass. Pour 45ml whisky over it for those drinking. For everyone else, pour ginger ale over ice with a squeeze of fresh lime. Drink with a scowl.
